To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose a novel approach to auto-scaling cloud resources that is based on user-defined performance requirements and financial budget constraints and show that it can reduce cloud computing costs significantly.

We present the first auto-scaling approach that considers both performance and budget concerns in the cloud, and we evaluate it in four representative cloud workflow patterns and show cost-savings from 9.6% to 40% compared to other auto-scaling approaches.
We propose a novel approach to cloud workflow management that dynamically allocates and deallocates virtual machines and schedules tasks to minimize cost while meeting application deadlines.

a new and challenging problem of how to minimize cloud costs while meeting application performance requirements.
the problem of minimizing financial cost while meeting application deadlines in the cloud.
the question: How do you minimize the cost of cloud workflows that have performance requirements?

we have developed an approach to cloud workflow scheduling that considers both user performance requirements (soft deadlines) and budget constraints.
the proposed approach provides the most effective solution for auto-scaling in cloud workflows.

the cost savings from auto-scaling is not a one-time event; rather, it is an ongoing process of dynamically allocating and deallocating resources as the workload and the user's financial situation change.

auto-scaling in the cloud can be achieved in a more intelligent way by considering both performance and budget concerns.
